title: Samsung chip fabs could deploy over 10,000 robots by 2030
html:
The number of robots operating in Samsung Electronics' semiconductor facilities could rise from about 100 in 2026 to more than 10,000 by 2030 as the South Korean chipmaker seeks to automate tasks that still require human labor.

Samsung Electronics' SAFER robot for semiconductor fab inspections, demonstrated in August 2026. Credit: Samsung Electronics
